Love of women, sons, gold, silver, horses, cattle and land is made attractive, but better are gardens, purified spouses and Allah's approval for those who fear Him.
Your properties and your children are only a trial, and with Allah is a great reward.
Those given wealth and children should not think Allah is hastening good things to them; they do not perceive.
The affluent of every city rejected their warner, claiming more wealth and children, but Allah extends and restricts provision, and only faith and righteous deeds bring people near Him.
Believers must not let their wealth and children divert them from remembering Allah, or they will be the losers.
Some wives and children are enemies to believers, so beware, yet if they pardon, Allah is Forgiving; wealth and children are only a trial, and Allah has a great reward.
Man thinks Allah's generosity honors him and restricted provision humiliates him, yet people neglect the orphan and feeding the poor, devour inheritance and love wealth intensely.
